name: FirstUK Bank Call Centre Script Guide
description: A comprehensive call centre script guide document for FirstUK Bank customer service staff, providing standardised communication protocols and procedures for call centre interactions. The guide is designed for use by call centre staff and customer service teams and is effective from 2026-01-15.
context: # FirstUK Bank — Call Centre Script Guide
Document ID | CC-SCRIPT-001
Audience | Call Centre Staff, Customer Service Team
Department | Customer Service, Call Centre

name: Call Centre Script for Common Customer Scenarios
description: A standardized call centre script designed to ensure consistent, professional service delivery and proper product knowledge across all team members handling common customer scenarios. The script provides a framework for call centre staff to follow when interacting with customers.
context: Provide standardized call centre scripts for common customer scenarios
ensure consistent, professional service and proper product knowledge across all team members

name: Opening Script (All Calls)
description: A standardised call centre script used to initiate all inbound customer calls at FirstUK Bank. The script establishes the customer relationship, captures the customer's name, identifies the reason for contact, and performs security verification using account number and date of birth before proceeding to assist the customer.
context: Agent: "Good morning/afternoon. You've reached FirstUK Bank. May I have your name, please?"
Agent: "Thank you, [Customer Name]. How can I help you today?"
For security, may I have the last 4 digits of your account number and your date of birth?
Agent: "Thank you. I've confirmed your details. Let me help you with [reason]."

name: Customer Name
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the customer's full name, captured during the opening greeting and used to personalise the agent's response throughout the call.
context: May I have your name, please?
Thank you, [Customer Name]. How can I help you today?

name: Call Reason
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the customer's stated reason for calling, captured after the initial greeting and used to direct the agent's assistance.
context: Customer explains reason for call
Agent: "Thank you. I've confirmed your details. Let me help you with [reason]."

name: Account Number Last 4 Digits
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the final four digits of the customer's account number, used as a security verification element during the call opening.
context: For security, may I have the last 4 digits of your account number and your date of birth?

name: Date of Birth
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the customer's date of birth, used as a security verification element to confirm customer identity before proceeding with assistance.
context: For security, may I have the last 4 digits of your account number and your date of birth?
Agent: "Thank you. I've confirmed your details."

name: Inbound Call Customer
description: A FirstUK Bank customer initiating an inbound call to the call centre. The customer is identified by name, account number (last 4 digits), and date of birth for security verification purposes.
context: You've reached FirstUK Bank. May I have your name, please?
For security, may I have the last 4 digits of your account number and your date of birth?
I've confirmed your details.

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A savings product offering competitive interest rates ranging from 4.50% to 4.80% AER depending on customer balance, with no monthly fees. Available through multiple opening channels: online, in-branch, or by post.
context: I'd like to open a SmartSaver account.
Our SmartSaver account offers some of the best interest rates available. We currently offer 4.50% to 4.80% AER depending on your balance, with no monthly fees.
Do you have any questions about the SmartSaver?

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A new savings account being opened by a customer through one of three available channels: online, in-branch, or by post. The account is subject to interest rate terms and no monthly fees.
context: I'd like to open a SmartSaver account.
We have three ways to open an account: 1. Online at www.firstuk.bank/open-account (1-2 business days) 2. In one of our 12 branches (same day or next day) 3. By post (5-7 business days)

name: Customer
description: An individual seeking to open a new SmartSaver savings account. The customer is inquiring about account opening options and product features.

Which option works best for you?

name: Account Opening Inquiry Agent Script
description: A call centre agent script for handling customer inquiries about opening a SmartSaver account. The script presents three account opening channels (online, in-branch, postal), outlines required documentation for online opening, and provides timeframes for each method.
context: Agent: "Excellent choice! Our SmartSaver account offers some of the best interest rates available."
We have three ways to open an account: 1. Online at www.firstuk.bank/open-account (1-2 business days) 2. In one of our 12 branches (same day or next day) 3. By post (5-7 business days)
You'll need a UK Passport or Driving License, plus proof of address (utility bill, council tax, or bank statement). The process takes about 10 minutes.

Your current rate is 4.50% AER. If you'd like, I can show you how that's calculated and when your next interest payment is due.

context: Our SmartSaver rates are variable, which means they move with the Bank of England's base rate.
We maintain a fixed 2.5% margin above the BoE rate, so your rate always stays competitive.

name: Failed Transaction Agent Script
description: A call centre script for agents handling customer inquiries about failed transfers or transactions. The script guides agents through investigation of the failure reason (insufficient funds, invalid recipient, closed account, or other), retrieval of transaction records, and offer of appropriate resolution based on the specific failure scenario.
context: Agent: "I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into this for you."
I can see what happened. The transfer failed because [reason: insufficient funds/invalid recipient/account closed/other].
Here's what we can do: [Offer resolution based on scenario]
[If insufficient funds:] "Once you have enough balance, we can resubmit the transfer immediately."

name: Transfer Attempt Timestamp
description: A dynamic placeholder capturing the date and time when the customer attempted the transfer. Used in the Failed Transaction Agent Script to establish the timeline of the failed transaction.
context: When did you attempt the transfer?

name: Transfer Amount
description: A dynamic placeholder for the monetary value of the transfer that failed. Captured from the customer during the call to identify the specific transaction.
context: How much was it for?

name: Recipient Account Details
description: A dynamic placeholder for the recipient account information (account number or identifier) to which the customer attempted to transfer funds. Used to verify the validity of the recipient and diagnose transfer failures.
context: To which account?
Can you double-check the account number?

name: Transfer Failure Reason
description: A dynamic placeholder capturing the specific reason why the transfer failed — insufficient funds, invalid recipient, account closed, or other. Retrieved from the transaction record and communicated to the customer.
context: The transfer failed because [reason: insufficient funds/invalid recipient/account closed/other].

name: Failed Transfer Transaction
description: A transfer transaction initiated by a customer that did not complete successfully. The agent retrieves the transaction record to diagnose the failure and offer appropriate resolution.
context: My transfer didn't go through.
[Pull transaction record]
I can see what happened. The transfer failed because [reason].

name: Transaction Investigation and Resolution Obligation
description: The agent must investigate failed transactions by retrieving transaction records, identifying the failure reason, and offering appropriate resolution to the customer based on the specific scenario (insufficient funds, invalid recipient, closed account, or other).
context: Let me check your account... [Pull transaction record]
I can see what happened. The transfer failed because [reason].
Here's what we can do: [Offer resolution based on scenario]

name: Fraud/Unauthorized Transaction Response Script
description: A call centre agent script for handling customer reports of unauthorized transactions. The script guides agents through immediate fraud investigation procedures, including transaction blocking, refund timelines, and customer protective actions. It establishes a 10-day refund commitment and 5-business-day follow-up contact.
context: I'm very sorry to hear that. We take fraud seriously and will investigate immediately.
I'm going to: 1. Block any suspicious transactions right away 2. Investigate what happened 3. Refund you within 10 days if the transaction is confirmed as unauthorized
We'll follow up with you within 5 business days with our findings.

name: Transaction Identifier
description: A placeholder variable capturing which specific transaction the customer identifies as unauthorized. Used in the fraud investigation script to isolate the disputed transaction.
context: Which transaction is unauthorized?

name: Transaction Occurrence Date
description: A placeholder variable capturing the date or timeframe when the unauthorized transaction occurred. Used to establish the timeline for fraud investigation.
context: When did it occur?

name: Transaction Amount
description: A placeholder variable capturing the monetary value of the unauthorized transaction. Used to assess the scale of the fraud and inform investigation priority.
context: How much was it for?

name: Customer Contact Phone Number
description: A placeholder variable capturing the customer's phone number for follow-up contact regarding fraud investigation findings. Used to establish the communication channel for the 5-business-day update.
context: Is there a phone number where we can reach you?

name: Unauthorized Transaction Report
description: A customer-reported unauthorized transaction triggering immediate fraud investigation, transaction blocking, and a refund commitment within 10 days if confirmed. The alert initiates a structured response including account monitoring recommendations and 5-business-day follow-up.
context: I see a transaction I didn't authorize.
We take fraud seriously and will investigate immediately.
Block any suspicious transactions right away

name: Unauthorized Transaction Refund Obligation
description: A mandatory obligation to refund the customer within 10 days if an unauthorized transaction is confirmed. This is a time-bound commitment triggered by fraud investigation completion.
context: Refund you within 10 days if the transaction is confirmed as unauthorized

name: Fraud Investigation Follow-up Obligation
description: A mandatory obligation to contact the customer within 5 business days with findings from the fraud investigation. This ensures timely communication of investigation outcomes and next steps.
context: We'll follow up with you within 5 business days with our findings.

name: Suspicious Transaction Blocking Obligation
description: An immediate operational obligation to block any suspicious transactions identified during fraud investigation. This is a preventive measure executed without delay upon fraud report.
context: Block any suspicious transactions right away

name: Unauthorized Transaction Activity
description: A customer-reported transaction that the account holder does not recognize or authorize. This is a primary fraud indicator requiring immediate investigation, transaction blocking, and protective account measures.
context: I see a transaction I didn't authorize.

name: Fraud Report Customer
description: A customer who reports an unauthorized transaction on their account. The customer is the primary party in the fraud investigation process and receives refund and protective action commitments.
context: Customer: "I see a transaction I didn't authorize."
Can you tell me: - Which transaction is unauthorized? - When did it occur? - How much was it for?

name: Unauthorized Transaction
description: A financial transaction on a customer account that the account holder reports as unauthorized. The transaction is subject to immediate investigation, potential blocking, and refund within 10 days if confirmed as fraudulent.
context: Which transaction is unauthorized?
Block any suspicious transactions right away
Refund you within 10 days if the transaction is confirmed as unauthorized

name: Complaint Handling Call Script
description: A call centre script for agents to follow when a customer initiates a complaint. The script guides the agent to document the complaint details, explain the investigation timeline (8 calendar days), inform the customer of the response method (email), and provide escalation information regarding the Financial Ombudsman Service. A complaint reference number is generated and provided to the customer for record-keeping.
context: I'm sorry you've had a poor experience. We want to make this right. Let me document your complaint.

I'm escalating this to our Complaints Team. Here's what happens next: 1. We'll investigate within 8 calendar days 2. You'll receive a response by email with our findings 3. If you disagree, you can escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service (free and independent)
Your complaint reference number is [EXC-XXXXX]. Please keep this for your records.
We'll be in touch within 8 days.

name: Complaint Description
description: A free-text variable capturing the customer's account of what went wrong. Collected during the complaint call and used to populate the complaint record for investigation.
context: Can you tell me: - What happened?

name: Complaint Occurrence Date
description: A date variable capturing when the complained-of event occurred. Collected from the customer to establish the timeline and context for investigation.
context: Can you tell me: - When did it occur?

name: Customer Resolution Request
aliases: How Would You Like Us to Resolve It
description: A free-text variable capturing the customer's desired outcome or remedy for the complaint. Collected during the complaint call to inform the investigation and resolution approach.
context: Can you tell me: - How would you like us to resolve it?

name: Complaint Reference Number
description: A unique identifier assigned to each complaint at the point of logging. The reference number is provided to the customer for record-keeping and used to track the complaint through investigation and resolution.
context: Your complaint reference number is [EXC-XXXXX]. Please keep this for your records.

name: Complaint Investigation Timeframe
description: A mandatory obligation to investigate and respond to a customer complaint within 8 calendar days of receipt. The bank must provide findings and a response to the customer by email within this timeframe.
context: We'll investigate within 8 calendar days
You'll receive a response by email with our findings
We'll be in touch within 8 days.

name: Complaint Documentation Requirement
description: A mandatory obligation for the agent to document the customer's complaint, including what happened, when it occurred, and the customer's desired resolution. This documentation forms the basis of the complaint record for investigation.
context: Let me document your complaint.
Can you tell me: - What happened? - When did it occur? - How would you like us to resolve it?

name: Complaint Escalation to Financial Ombudsman Service
description: A mandatory obligation to inform customers of their right to escalate unresolved complaints to the Financial Ombudsman Service, which is described as free and independent. This information must be provided during the complaint handling process.
context: If you disagree, you can escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service (free and independent)

name: Complaining Customer
description: A customer who has initiated a complaint regarding their banking experience or service. The customer provides details of the complaint and receives a reference number and timeline for investigation and response.
context: Customer: "I want to file a complaint."
[Customer explains]

name: Account Closure Agent Script
description: A call centre script for handling customer-initiated account closure requests. The script guides agents through explaining the closure process, calculating final balances, cancelling standing orders and Direct Debits, offering fund transfer options, and attempting retention before processing the closure.
context: Agent: "I'm sorry to hear you want to close your account. Before you go, may I ask why? This helps us improve."

I understand. Let me explain the closure process: 1. We'll calculate your final balance (including pending interest) 2. Cancel any standing orders or Direct Debits 3. Transfer any remaining funds to your new bank 4. Your account will be closed
The process takes 5-7 business days. How would you like to receive your final balance? - Transfer to another UK bank account (1-2 days) - Cheque in the post (3-5 days) - Cash in a branch (same day)
I've processed your closure request. Your account will close in 5-7 days. We appreciate your business.

name: Final Balance
description: The calculated account balance at closure, including any pending interest accrued up to the closure date. This variable is presented to the customer and used to determine the transfer amount.
context: We'll calculate your final balance (including pending interest)
How would you like to receive your final balance?

name: Closure Processing Timeframe
description: The standard timeframe for completing account closure after the customer's request is processed, stated as 5-7 business days.
context: The process takes 5-7 business days.
Your account will close in 5-7 days.

name: Fund Transfer Method
description: The customer's chosen method for receiving their final balance upon account closure: transfer to another UK bank account, cheque by post, or cash in branch.
context: How would you like to receive your final balance? - Transfer to another UK bank account (1-2 days) - Cheque in the post (3-5 days) - Cash in a branch (same day)

name: Customer Account

context: I'd like to close my account.

name: Card Replacement Agent Script
description: Agent call script for handling customer requests to replace a lost or damaged card. name: Prohibition on Undeliverable Promises
description: Staff must never promise customers outcomes, solutions, or services that cannot be reliably delivered or guaranteed.
context: Never promise what you can't deliver

name: Use of Document References for Product Accuracy
description: When answering product questions, staff must reference authoritative product and policy documents to ensure accuracy and consistency.
context: Use document references ([[products]], [[policies]]) to answer product questions accurately

name: Customer Escalation to Formal Complaint
description: When a customer explicitly escalates an interaction to a formal complaint, this signals a breakdown in the initial resolution attempt and requires immediate escalation.
context: Customer escalates to complaint

name: Customer Extreme Emotional Distress
description: When a customer becomes very upset or angry, this is a warning sign that the interaction requires immediate de-escalation and escalation to a supervisor.
context: Customer very upset/angry
